kelmarsh.title: Kelmarsh wind farm data
kelmarsh.timestamp_semantics: Greenbyte export preamble declares UTC. Interval anchoring was not established.
kelmarsh.status_semantics: UTC event logs are separate CSV members and are not joined to SCADA. Per-row status_code is null and operational_state is unknown.
kelmarsh.coverage: Publisher release spans 2016–2024 across six Senvion MM92 turbines. Retrieved archive contains 2016 data for turbines 1–6.

penmanshiel.title: Penmanshiel wind farm data
penmanshiel.timestamp_semantics: Greenbyte export preamble declares UTC. Interval anchoring was not established.
penmanshiel.status_semantics: UTC event logs are separate CSV members and are not joined to SCADA. Per-row status_code is null and operational_state is unknown.
penmanshiel.coverage: Publisher release spans 2016–2024 with variable channel and turbine coverage across fourteen Senvion MM82 turbines, excluding WT03. Retrieved archive contains 2016 data for turbines 11–15.

la_haute_borne.title: La Haute Borne wind farm SCADA
la_haute_borne.timestamp_semantics: OpenOA documents historical exports with explicit +01:00 or +02:00 offsets. The adapter requires an explicit offset and converts to UTC.
la_haute_borne.status_semantics: No publisher event or status labels verified. Adapter emits null status_code and unknown operational_state.
la_haute_borne.coverage: Historical export schema documented by OpenOA. Publisher data acquisition blocked.
